title: Structured Date
description: A date with semantic type. Aligns with DataCite Date (property 8). Supports single dates, date ranges (YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD), and year-only precision. Use 'Collected' for data acquisition periods, 'Issued' for publication date, 'Created' for dataset creation.

date_information.description: Free-text detail about the date (e.g., 'EEG recording sessions' for a Collected date).
